what_happened: PR-head review worktree built in ~4 minutes instead of a full cold build: symlinked the main tree's .lake/packages (9.2G, unchanged manifest) into the worktree and real-copied only .lake/build/lib + .lake/build/ir (2.1G, 3.5s), leaving .lake/build/bin and the five .lake/build-guard.* runtime files uncopied as the guard's header requires. lake then re-elaborated only the 7 changed modules (1920 jobs, all cache hits otherwise).

Not copying .lake/build/bin into the review worktree made check-module-invariants.sh C25 (every lean_exe root compiles) relink all 60 executables from scratch, adding several minutes to the full invariants pass. A future PR-head worktree should either copy build/bin too or run the invariants pass with --no-build plus a targeted lake build.
